entities.summary: J'Kaylin Dobbins is an American professional football running back for the Denver Broncos of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ohio State Buckeyes and was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the second round of the 2020 NFL draft. He spent four seasons with the Ravens before joining the Los Angeles Chargers for the 2024 NFL season.
